cc:Work.dc:title: figure1_task_relevant_acquisition_framework
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Task-relevant information acquisition framework. Part I characterizes spatial, sparse, objective-conditioned, and state-conditioned task information. Part II tests its realization through legal-state valuation, matched source controls, bounded planning, and the frozen endpoint. Usefulness, task-value observability, and actionability are validation criteria.
